BREAKOUT TRADE SETUP — place a BRACKET order on the Breakout terminal.
RULES (do all): attach SL **and** TP at entry; never place without both. If now is past 'Valid until' OR the live price is outside the entry band, DO NOT place — reply 'skipped: stale/out-of-range'. Do NOT manage the exit yourself — the bracket is the exit.

  ⚠️  CUSHION UNKNOWN — the account's distance to its account-killer limits could
     not be established (the account-status snapshot is absent — a cushion that cannot be shown to be current is not a cushion).
     Send a fresh balance (`bal <balance> <equity>`) before placing, and size off
     YOUR live balance — the suggested size below is not checked against any limit.

  Strategy : trend_donchian_sol_prop
  Symbol   : SOLUSD
  Side     : Buy (long)
  Size     : 15.0 SOL — SUGGESTED size at the nominal $5000 (= $75.00 risk at the stop). RECOMPUTE against your live balance (see Sizing).
  Sizing   : RISK 1.5% of your CURRENT live balance. Risk per 1 SOL at the stop = $5.0000. FINAL size = (1.5% × your live balance) ÷ $5.0000. Last step before placing: read the live balance, do this calc, then size.
  Entry    : 150.0   (only if live price is within 148.75 … 151.25)
  Stop     : 145.0
  Target   : 162.0   (R:R ≈ 2.4)

  Order type: LIMIT at entry with attached bracket + day/GTD expiry if supported (so a stale signal simply doesn't fill); else market ONLY if price is in-band.
  Signal time: 2026-09-27T12:00:00+00:00
  Valid until: 2026-09-27T13:00:00+00:00

  Prop context ($5000 1-Step Classic): this risks $75.00 (1.5% of balance). Account killers — daily loss $150 (3%), static drawdown floor $300 (6% off start). Breaching either permanently disables the account.

  REPORT BACK (required) — after you act, reply with ONE copy-paste JSON
  block so the system can track this trade (paste it into the dashboard
  Prop tab report-back form, or send it to Claude). Fill the <…> values:
    placed : {"account_id":"breakout_1","symbol":"SOLUSDT","direction":"long","status":"open","entry_price":<your fill>,"qty":<size you placed>,"sl":<stop you set>,"tp":<target you set>,"ticket_id":"prop-manual-golden"}
    skipped: {"account_id":"breakout_1","symbol":"SOLUSDT","direction":"long","status":"skipped","reason":"stale/out-of-range","ticket_id":"prop-manual-golden"}
    closed : {"account_id":"breakout_1","symbol":"SOLUSDT","direction":"long","status":"closed","entry_price":<fill>,"exit_price":<exit>,"qty":<size>,"pnl":<usd>,"reason":"tp|sl|manual","ticket_id":"prop-manual-golden"}
    moved stop/target: {"kind":"amend","account_id":"breakout_1","symbol":"SOLUSDT","direction":"long","sl":<new stop>,"tp":<new target, or omit>}
